title: fleet hibernation record v1
description: ONE HIBERNATION: the sessions that were running when it was recorded, where each sat, and what has happened to each since. <HORDE_HOME>/fleet/hibernations/<id>/record.json, written whole and renamed into place by fleet/Hibernation.ps1, and read by fleet/Wake.ps1. Horde's own record: a wake reads this, never a terminal plugin's saved layouts. A SESSION IS KEYED BY ITS SESSION ID, never by its pane number, which a terminal reuses after a restart. Every optional member is left out when it is not known; nothing is written as null. What the schema cannot say is checked in fleet/Hibernation.ps1: each session id appears once, and the id is the folder's name.

id.description: The UTC time the hibernation was recorded, yyyymmdd-hhmmss; also its folder's name.

agent.description: The harness adapter (agents/<name>/Fleet.ps1) whose liveness rule chose the sessions and whose resume line wakes them.

host.description: The terminal adapter (hosts/<name>/Fleet.ps1) that read the placement and spawns the woken panes.

selection.description: How the sessions were chosen, so a reader can tell 'all' from 'these'.

kind.description: all: every running, unretired session but the master. labels: exactly the sessions named. orcs: horde fleet hibernate - each Orc named (by label or lane folder) and its wargs, less the exclusions.

labels.description: The labels asked for (for orcs, the names given: labels or lane folders); empty for all.

exclude.description: The labels left out on purpose.

parkedBy.description: Who parked it, in plain words: a session label, or a session id when it has none. Written with the record; the lot row (fleet-parking-lot.v1) holds the id of the parking session, when known.

phase.description: Written by horde fleet hibernate only. asking: the record is written and each session is being asked to park. parking: the asks are out and sessions are being sent their exit as each parks. done: every session is exited or still-awake. A record with no phase was made by fleet record and is not a hibernation in progress.

excluded.description: Written by horde fleet hibernate: the sessions the selection named that were left running on purpose, each with its reason.

sessions.description: At least one: an empty hibernation is never written.

expectedStarts.description: Written by a wake BEFORE it starts anything: the sessions it is about to start, and the window in which they will. Horde's restore source can read this to treat those starts as expected rather than as a restore it did not make (not read by it yet).

utc.description: A UTC time to the second.

sessionId.description: The harness's own session id, a lower-case uuid.

path.description: A path on this machine, one line.

state.description: recorded: in the record, still running when it was taken. asked: asked to park. parked: its PARKED file is written. exited: its process has ended. still-awake: a wake found it running (or could not prove it was not) and left it alone. waking: its pane was spawned and it has not yet been seen running. woken: seen running again, and told so. failed: the wake tried and it did not come up, or could not be told.

placement.description: Where the session's pane sat when it was recorded, from the terminal's own pane list. windowKey groups the panes of one window; it is the terminal's own text and means nothing after that terminal restarts except 'these sat together'.

tabIndex.description: The tab's place in its window's tab bar, from 0.

left.description: The pane's left column within its tab.

top.description: The pane's top row within its tab.

tabCols.description: The width of the whole tab, so a split's share can be computed.

reason.description: One plain word: the master; the session running the command; the fleet analyst service; a session with no label, whose PARKED file could not be named; the founder typed into it in the last 30 minutes; its transcript could not be read, so that could not be ruled out; an Orc with an open question waiting on the founder.
Why, in plain words, when the move needs one (a refusal, a failure).

pane.description: The pane a wake started for it, when it failed after that: a later wake holds it until -Retry, since it may still be loading there.

role.description: Read from the fleet registry through core/Roles.ps1. A missing or unknown role is other, never guessed.

parent.description: The session that owns it, as the fleet registry says. A wake puts a session in the window of its nearest owning orc in the same record.

pane.description: The terminal pane it sat in when it was recorded, from the fleet registry; a hint only, a terminal reuses pane ids. Copied to its row of the lot (fleet-lot-member.v1).

process.description: The process that ran it when it was recorded, as the harness adapter names it: its pid and its start time (FILETIME ticks). A wake treats that very process still running, under any id, as this session running. Left out when the harness could not name it; a wake then does not narrow its check of the session's folder.

parkedFile.description: Its PARKED-<label>.md, when the file was there.

history.description: Every state it has been in, oldest first; the last is state.

wokenAs.description: The id it came back under, when the harness gave the resumed conversation a new one.
